command: set -euo pipefail; test -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb start-server >/dev/null; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')"; test -n "$serial"; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "1"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; echo DEVICE_MODEL=$model
